$description: Snapshot of a Figma library, written by packages/tokens/scripts/figma/export.js. Don't edit by hand: refresh it from Figma. The drift tests check the token sources and figma.ts against it.

65:62.name: Kicker
65:62.description: Post type label. Text is bound to type/label, so it reads the card's Post Type mode; no text property needed.

65:65.name: Check Row

Label.default: Wired the tokens into the site shell

65:65.description: One line of a Ledger or Before / After card. Check (type ink) for shipped, Cross (error) for the mistake, Dot for a note. Struck=Yes is the subtraction ledger: what was cut. Real item names at uneven lengths; 6 rows at most.

65:86.name: Token Chip
65:86.description: A component or token chip for Architecture Diagram zones and Pipeline outputs. Override the swatch fill with the real token.

65:89.name: Arrow
65:89.description: One arrow per card. The annotation carries the rule. A diagram that needs two arrows is two cards.

65:94.name: Equals Badge
65:94.description: The whole argument of a Parity card. Sits on the hairline between the Figma half and the code half.

65:96.name: Terminal
65:96.description: The hero of a Pipeline card: one real command. Content never invents: use the command that actually ran.

65:99.name: Zone Label
65:99.description: Sits on the top edge of a dashed zone (absolute, y = -18). Names the zone: PRIMITIVES, FIGMA, BEFORE…

36:31.description: A short uppercase label chip. .lk-tag. Used in a wrapping row of 4px gaps (profile tags, Link Row tags).

36:33.name: Icon Kicker
36:33.description: Category label above a row or tile title: a 16px icon in a 4px box, then a mono uppercase label in scrim at 80%. .lk-kicker. Studio uses the Command glyph; Blog Feather; Shop and Support Layout Grid.

36:50.name: Pill Button
36:50.description: Header link (Ghost) and Follow (Outlined). Mono 11px, full radius. .lk-header__link, .lk-follow. Focus draws a 2px primary ring; code has none yet. Ghost hides below 640px in the header.

36:67.name: Icon Button
36:67.description: 32px round button on inverse-surface; the icon takes inverse-on-surface. Social: 18px icon (.lk-social). Go: 20px chevron at the end of a Link Row (.lk-row__go). Hover lifts to primary; code has no hover yet. Needs an aria-label in code (the social kind).

36:96.name: Tab
36:96.description: Filter tab: a toggle button (aria-pressed), 46px tall, 10px radius, comic lettering. .lk-tab. Selected sits on surface-container-lowest with an outline. Fills its grid cell (FILL width) in a row of five.

36:107.name: Avatar
36:107.description: Round profile photo with a 1px on-surface ring over tertiary-98 (shown when there is no photo). Large 172px; Compact 120px below 640px. .lk-avatar. Photo fill: Imagery/Portrait.
